verdict.rationale: dlt lets the user choose where loaded data lands: any supported destination, including a local DuckDB file, switchable without changing pipeline code. Pipelines also run wherever Python runs, so data can stay on infrastructure the user controls. Nothing documents region or residency selection as such, especially for dltHub managed infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for dltHub managed infrastructure, documentation of data-residency guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This approach is especially useful when switching between destinations without modifying the actual pipeline code.
Write the pipeline in Python and run it wherever Python already runs: a laptop, a notebook, Airflow, Dagster, a Lambda, a container.
dlt supports a variety of popular destinations and has an interface to add custom destinations
